title: Good app but could be better
body:
Its a good app but I’m not sure it’s worth the money. It should be a lot more customizable for that price. 
It’s very frustrating that you can’t add your mood to a day if it’s after midnight. You should be able to click on a specific date on the mood calendar to add your mood if forgotten throughout the day. There should also be way more options when choosing keywords to describe your mood. 
Also there isn’t enough personalization in the habits. If you only want to do a habit once a week you have to add it to a specific day otherwise it will show up every day, that doesn’t allow for flexibility in your routine and it hurts your habit rates. Besides this it would be great if you could see how far you are with a habit. So if you want to drink 8 glasses of water a day but only drink 5, it should say on the overview of all habits (on that specific habit) 5/8, that would be way more motivating. You should also be able to both add time as in how many minutes for a task and times as in how many times a day.
Lastly it’s annoying that you can’t add tags to your habit when you’re creating it instead you have to do that after the habit is created.
